purpose: Structured goals for every project: a validating CLI for agents, a slim generated goals.md, and a local dashboard.

items.title: Tour and Stage views with count bars
items.body: Uncommitted: cross-project Tour page, per-project Stage setlist of now items, CountBar per phase, server project summary.
items.note: Setlist redesign: Tour overview, Stage header with Now setlist, count bars in sidebar and sections, done/dropped stamps, summary API with phases and now items

items.title: React dashboard
items.note: Project sidebar, filters and search, expand rows, edit modal, phase/status/done/drop/reopen, drag and Alt+Up/Down reorder, section management, multi-select copy, live SSE, virtualized list.

items.title: Dashboard design pass
items.note: Cards no longer collapse on long projects, solid surfaces instead of glass, no accent bars, ease-out entrances, chips colored per phase/status/size/scope.

items.title: Progress % weighted by item size
items.body: Done share weighs S=1, M=2, L=4, unsized counts as M, instead of a plain item count.
items.note: percentDone in src/core/summary.ts, S=1 M=2 L=4, unsized=M; used by Stage, Tour, section bars. Check: tests/summary.test.ts

items.title: Suggestions tab
items.body: Agents add ideas with upgo suggestion add (suggestions.json). Dashboard panel: tick to copy for an agent, add to goals, or dismiss.
items.note: upgo suggestion add|list|delete into gitignored suggestions.json; Goals/Suggestions tabs with goal-style rows: Add to goals, copy, dismiss

items.title: Show the dropped reason on a near duplicate
items.body: When a suggestion looks like a dropped goal, show that goal and its reason right on the row.
items.note: Dropped before line on the row (goal chip that jumps to it, plus reason), same match rule as the CLI duplicate guard (src/core/similar.ts)

items.title: Undo for dismiss and drop
items.body: Undo toast after Dismiss and Drop, like goal ops already have.
items.note: Undo toast after Delete, Drop and Shift+add; deletes the made goals and restores suggestions at their old index (POST suggestions {restore})

items.title: Drop reason presets
items.body: Chips in the Drop prompt: Out of scope, Already done, Not worth it, Duplicate. Still allow free text.
items.note: Preset chips in the goal and suggestion Drop prompts fill the field, free text still works

items.title: One click adopt with defaults
items.body: Shift+click on Add to goals skips the modal and adds with the hinted section and phase `later`.
items.note: Shift+click Add to goals (row or bar) adds to Later in the hinted section; ones without a usable hint still open the form

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts in suggestions
items.body: j/k to move, a to add, d to drop, x to dismiss, space to tick.
items.note: not worth

items.body: Fix the title or body of a suggestion in the dashboard before deciding.
items.note: not worth

items.title: Search and sort suggestions
items.body: Filter by text, sort by newest or size. Reuse the goals FilterBar look.

items.body: One view on the overview listing every project's suggestions, grouped by project.

items.title: Merge suggestions

items.title: Dashboard counts archived done items
items.body: After upgo archive, project %, done counts and section bars only count goals.json, so a mostly done project drops toward 0%. Server should send archive counts and summarize/percentDone include them.
items.note: summarize and groupItems take the archive; server sends archived items and watches goals-archive.json

items.title: Related chip to an archived item
items.body: A related chip pointing at an archived item toasts 'No item X in Y'. Show it as archived instead.
items.note: jump and focus toast 'X is archived: upgo show p:X' instead of an error

items.title: Publish the repo
items.body: Untrack private files, sample import fixture, portable schema url and hook paths, MIT license, noreply email in history.
items.note: Private files untracked and purged from history, sample import fixture, GitHub schema url, MIT license, noreply email on every commit

items.title: Core: zod schema, store with lock and atomic save
items.note: goals.json per project, O_EXCL lock (stale after 10s), tmp+rename save, goals.schema.json emitted for VS Code.

items.title: CLI for every goals mutation
items.note: init, add, edit, show, list, done, drop, reopen, delete, move, section, trap, purpose, check, render, import, forget, ui. PATH shims upgo and upgo.cmd.

items.title: Check rules and slim goals.md renderer
items.note: Unique ids, sections, related refs, detail files, md in sync. goals.md: traps, now/next/later lines, counts for wayLater/maybe.

items.title: Importer for old hand-written goals.md
items.note: Converts the Velora, checkmark-list and narrative dialects plus goals-completed.md. Reports ignored lines; archive tables stay inside their record.

items.title: Git pre-commit and Claude edit-blocking hooks
items.note: Installed by init. Pre-commit runs upgo check for every upgo project in the repo; Claude hook blocks Edit/Write on schema-tagged goals.json and goals.md.

items.title: Local REST and SSE server
items.note: 127.0.0.1 only, custom header plus Origin check on mutations, projects by registry id, fs.watch pushes SSE. Vite dev port trusted only with UPGO_DEV=1.

items.title: Review hardening pass
items.note: goals.md written first so retries cannot double-add, lock cleanup never fails a write, init checks the registry first, CRLF purpose fix, list --search matches values only.

items.title: Related chips jump to the item
items.body: Related refs render as plain chips. App already opens a project at an item (`select(id, item)`), so a click can jump there, across projects too. Size S.
items.note: Related chips are buttons: same project jumps locally (shows closed items), other project opens it at the item, unknown project or item toasts

items.title: Render markdown in the dashboard
items.body: Bodies and detail files are markdown but show as plain text and a raw pre block, so backticks, lists and links read badly. A small sanitized markdown renderer (no raw HTML) for body and detail. Size M.
items.note: web/src/goals/Markdown.tsx: React-element renderer (headings, lists incl nested, code, fences, quotes, hr, bold/em, http/mailto links only). Used for item body, detail file, suggestions, traps. Test: tests/web/markdown.test.tsx

items.title: Undo toast for dashboard actions
items.body: Done, drop, phase change, move and delete have no undo besides git. An Undo button on the success toast that sends the inverse op: old status and note, old phase, move back next to the old neighbor, re-add the deleted item. Size M.
items.note: Undo on the success toast for done, drop, reopen, phase/status, move (menu, keys, drag) and delete; inverse ops in web/src/goals/undo.ts, a newer undo toast replaces the older one, re-added items keep their created date

items.title: upgo suggestion promote
items.body: Turning a suggestion into a goal from the CLI takes `upgo add` plus `upgo suggestion delete`, and the second step is easy to forget, so finished ideas linger in the panel. `upgo suggestion promote <id> --section N [--phase ..]` does both, reusing title and body. Size S.
items.note: upgo suggestion promote <id> --section N [--phase ..] adds the goal from title and body, then deletes the suggestion

items.title: Broken suggestions.json should not break the project
items.body: If suggestions.json is invalid, GET /api/projects/:id fails and the whole project shows an error instead of its goals. Have the server return the goals with a suggestions error shown in the panel, and have upgo check validate suggestions.json too.
items.note: Server returns goals plus suggestionsError shown in the Suggestions panel; upgo check reports a broken suggestions.json

items.title: Suggestions carry section and size
items.body: Agents set the section and size they would pick; promote and the dashboard reuse them.
items.note: suggestion add --section/--size, list shows hints, promote defaults to them, dashboard chips + prefilled Add item, Drop saves a dropped goal

items.title: upgo suggestion edit
items.body: `upgo suggestion edit <id> [--title t] [--body text] [--section N] [--size S|M|L]`, so agents can fix a suggestion without deleting and re-adding it.
items.note: upgo suggestion edit with --title/--body/--section/--size/--related and --clear

items.title: CLI suggestion drop
items.body: `upgo suggestion drop <id> --reason ... [--section N]`, same as the dashboard Drop, so agents can do it too.
items.note: upgo suggestion drop <id...> --reason, shares fromSuggestion with the dashboard Drop

items.title: Duplicate guard on suggestion add
items.body: Warn or refuse when a new suggestion matches an existing goal (open, done or dropped) by slug or similar title. `--force` to override.
items.note: add refuses slug or similar-title matches against goals and suggestions, --force overrides

items.title: Compact context for agents before suggesting
items.body: `upgo suggestion context`: prints all goal titles plus dropped titles with reasons in a few lines, so agents check before suggesting.
items.note: upgo suggestion context: open, done, dropped with reasons, pending

items.title: Related goals on suggestions
items.body: `related` refs on suggestions, rendered as chips like on goal rows. Carry over on adopt.
items.note: related on suggestions, validated on add/edit, chips in the panel, carried on adopt, promote and drop

items.body: Separate short rationale from the body, shown on the collapsed row as a caption.

items.title: Snooze a suggestion

items.title: Batch add suggestions
items.body: `upgo suggestion add --json <file|->` to add many at once with one lock and one write.

items.title: upgo next
items.body: Print the top now item (or first next) in full so an agent can pick up work with one command.
items.note: upgo next prints the first open now item (else next) in display order, in full

items.title: Per-item change history
items.body: Record created, phase moves, done and reopen with dates so you can see how an item travelled.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: Close goals from commit messages
items.body: A commit-msg hook that runs upgo done when the message says closes <id>, so agents never forget to finish an item.

items.title: upgo stale
items.body: List now and next items untouched for N days, the ones that quietly rot.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: upgo now across all projects
items.body: One command that prints every registered project's now items, for a terminal glance without the dashboard.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: upgo undo
items.body: Keep the previous goals.json on every write and restore it with one command after a bad agent edit.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: upgo check --fix
items.body: Auto-fix the safe problems (goals.md out of sync, missing dates) instead of just reporting them.

items.title: Archive old done items
items.body: Move done items older than N months to goals-archive.json so goals.json stays small and fast for agents.
items.note: upgo archive [--months 6] moves old done items to goals-archive.json; refs, show, check, hook and suggestion dupes still see them

items.title: Fuzzy id matching
items.body: Accept a unique prefix or near id in show, done and edit, and suggest the closest id on a typo.

items.title: MCP server for upgo
items.body: Expose list, show, add and done as MCP tools so agents call upgo natively instead of shelling out.

items.title: Shell completions for ids and sections
items.body: Tab-complete commands, item ids and section numbers in PowerShell and bash.
